name: symphony-workflow
description: Repo-local Agent Harness auditing, minimal Issue planning, and PR autopilot for reliable Agent workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Agent Harness audits, minimal Issue planning, and PR automation.
interface.longDescription: Audit repo-local Agent guidance, evidence, checks, and drift; shape broad intents into minimal linked Issues; and keep Pull Requests merge-ready within Issue-authorized scope while deferring non-blocking review hardening.
defaultPrompt: Use $harness-audit to audit this repository's Agent Harness.
Use $intent-to-issues to decide whether a broad goal needs decomposition.
Use $intent-to-issues after confirmation to prepare GitHub Issues.
Use $autopilot to keep the current Pull Request merge-ready within its Issue-authorized scope by handling conflicts, blocking review findings, and CI failures.
